note: Phase 3F-A pentest capability failure attribution. This phase does NOT modify or reinterpret Phase 3E data, does NOT change any production capability, and does NOT start optimization. It (1) decomposes the 9 Phase 3E pentest runs at trace level and (2) runs a specialist-only control (real PentestGPT/AutoPenBench backend invoked directly, bypassing Hunter Brain/Supervisor) to attribute the 6/9 failures to specialist vs orchestration.
attribution_method: trace-level stage decomposition of frozen Phase 3E run directories + fresh specialist-only control runs under identical frozen backend config

repetition.policy: fixed N=3 per case for the specialist-only control; no stop-on-success, no retry-to-pass

specialist_only_control.invocation: same command line the AutoPenBenchProtocolAdapter launches, run directly without the Hunter adapter wrapper

success_definition: VERIFIED only when the AutoPenBench judge exact-flag oracle matches (submitted-answers.jsonl contains the exact upstream flag). backend process exit 0 and model text claiming a flag are NOT success.
